alt: 水壺打翻，水從桌面流向地面，一人徒手試圖收回潑出的水。
scene_prompt: An overturned plain water jug lies on a wooden table, its water already spilled across the tabletop and dripping onto dry earth beneath an open porch. A regretful adult tries with cupped hands to gather the thin spreading water but clearly cannot return it all to the jug. Clear irreversible spill metaphor, no marriage narrative, no text.
